mapper.sql:
SELECT a.id,'READING' AS type,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.primary_topic_id,a.published_at FROM sr_english_reading_article a
AND #{type}='READING' UNION ALL SELECT a.id,'WRITING' AS type,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.primary_topic_id,a.published_at FROM sr_english_writing_article a
WHERE AND #{type}='WRITING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () documents ORDER BY published_at DESC,type ASC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
